abstract: <jats:p>This study reports the demonstration of optical refrigeration in Yb doped yttrium-aluminosilicate glasses, showing near-unity quantum efficiencies anti-Stokes fluorescence, allowing net optical refrigeration up to −2.4 K under atmospheric pressure.</jats:p>
